newsitem.title: CHINA: Wang On says to place 30 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Wang On says to place 30 mln new shares.

text.p: Wang On Group Ltd said on Monday it would raise HK$32 million after expenses through an issue of 30 million new shares to substantial shareholder Middlemore Ltd.

Wang On said Middlemore had agreed to place 30 million existing company shares to independent institutional investors at HK$1.10 each before it subscribed the same amount of new shares at a net placing price after expenses.
"The net proceeds will be used for the expansion in Chinese wet markets, car parks and shopping centre management business purposes," the company said.
Wang On's chairman Tang Ching Ho holds 56.94 percent of the company through Middlemore and Caister Ltd. Tang's stake in the company will be diluted to 50.33 percent after the deal, it said.
Wang On shares fell HK$0.11 or 8.3 percent to HK$1.21 by midsession.
